definitions.explanation: A student who transfers into a school, university, or program partway through, typically entering at a year other than the first. Common in the Japanese university system where students from junior colleges or technical colleges transfer into the third year of a four-year university.

examples.japanese: {編入生|へんにゅうせい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: To enter a university as a transfer student.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{編入生|へんにゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十名|じゅうめい}⟦{入学|にゅうがく}した→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Ten transfer students enrolled this year.

examples.japanese: {編入生|へんにゅうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三年次|さんねんじ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since transfer students join classes from the third year, it can sometimes be difficult to make friends.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{編入|へんにゅう}→編入：13887_hennyuu⟧ (transfer, incorporation) and {生|せい} (student). Specifically refers to students who enter a school or university at a point other than the normal starting point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編入生|へんにゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to accept transfer students
- {編入生|へんにゅうせい}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明会|せつめいかい}→説明会：03087_setsumeikai⟧: orientation for transfer students
- {三年次|さんねんじ}{編入生|へんにゅうせい}: third-year transfer student

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, ⟦{編入|へんにゅう}→編入：13887_hennyuu⟧ is a well-established pathway in higher education. Students from ⟦{短期大学|たんきだいがく}→短期大学：27098_tankidaigaku⟧ (junior colleges) or {高等専門学校|こうとうせんもんがっこう} (technical colleges) often transfer into the third year of a four-year university. This requires passing a separate ⟦{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}→編入試験：22054_hennyuushiken⟧ (transfer examination).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧: transfer student (between schools of the same level) — typically used for elementary through high school
- ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧: international student — a student studying abroad
- ⟦{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}→編入試験：22054_hennyuushiken⟧: transfer examination — the entrance exam for transfer admission
